positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Backend engineer for the Personal Loan platform, developing services that power the loan application funnel, credit decisioning systems, and customer verification workflows
• Led development of an underwriting platform upgrade, replacing a legacy Drools rules engine with a more scalable system design, improving maintainability and increasing loan originations by $20M/month
• Designed and executed migration of 8M+ documents from legacy distributed storage to Google Cloud Storage, implementing a phased rollout with zero downtime and resolving critical cross-service dependencies
• Built and enhanced customer verification systems, integrating external financial data providers (e.g., Plaid) to increase auto-approval rates and reduce manual review
• Designed and maintained event-driven, distributed workflows with robust retry and recovery mechanisms (Pub/Sub-based systems)
• Debugged and resolved complex production issues involving data inconsistencies, race conditions, and multi-service interactions
• Partnered with Risk and Data Science to implement and refine real-time decisioning systems, including rule evaluation, feature sourcing, and fraud signal integration
• Implemented observability and reliability improvements using New Relic for monitoring, logging, and alerting, enabling faster incident response and performance tuning

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on a dashboard that provided new configuration and reporting capabilities using ReactJS, GraphQL and Spring Boot deployed on AWS GovCloud
• Worked on the shopping portal which provides healthcare services to consumers using predominantly JSP and SpringMVC
• Upgraded our monolithic code base to Spring 5 and OpenJDK 16
• Developed end to end changes on Covered CA in accordance with a newly amended California Bill that would give state subsidies to struggling families
• Designed and implemented an HTTP retry architecture which saved requests that would fail due to 5xx errors to be later re-attempted
• Used Spring Batch to create jobs that asynchronously verify applicant information using external sources such as, the IRS, Social Security Administration and Medicare

positions.title: IT Engineer
positions.description:
• Helped build a QA automation framework to automate a majority of the team’s regressive test cases using Oracle Application Testing Suite (OATS), Jenkins, MongoDB, Spring MVC and AngularJS
• Worked on rebuilding our legacy accruals application running on JSP to a cloud-native
architecture using AngularJS and Spring Boot
• Helped migrate some of our team’s applications to OpenShift container platform in order to
speed up deployment, provide better monitoring and allow higher reliability
• Developed functionality to upload and modify user stories, test cases, test results and defects for regressive test cases from the QA automation dashboard to Rally Agile Tool
• Developed a microservice to download and upload files to our internal document repository
• Developed microservices to handle data coming from other systems and inserting into our
own databases
• Created XLSX reporting functionality on one of our Spring MVC applications using
Apache POI
• Developed a Cisco Spark bot using Spring Boot and Apache Tomcat to handle business users’ automation requests using Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
• Developed PL/SQL scripts to automate AR setups in Oracle ERP
• Designed and implemented a framework on Oracle Database to schedule and dynamically run SQL queries and email results to users in excel format
• Worked directly with business users to produce ad-hoc SQL’s during quarter end support

positions.title: IT Customer Engagement Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked with the Customer Engagement team to provide the proper infrastructure to support the requirements of NetApp’s application teams
•	Automated our weekly and monthly metrics to provide real-time, on demand metrics for the team and remove possible human error from manually generated metrics

projects.title: NFC Locker
projects.description: Designed and built a scalable locker system that uses NFC technology. NFC lockers are activated from smartphone's NFC chip
